Name: Sewer Lewis
Author: himanbam
Description:
Lewis lives in the sewer now.

Basically a reskin of Krobus to make him look like Lewis.

Can be used with my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11374]Mayor Krobus[/url].


*Note this does not change his name,  birthday, or any dialogue.
However if you want those changes, you can use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271]Ultimate Villager Manager[/url] mod by ApollyonSV. Then, change the config as described below.


[line][b]
[size=4]Ultimate Villager Manager Config Instructions:
[/size][/b]
Go to the Krobus section.
Change Krobus' name to Lewis.
You can also change his birthday to Lewis' birthday (Spring 7).
That mod will update dialogue and events to use the new name.

[size=4][b]
My Config Instructions:[/b][/size]

If using Ultimate Villager Manager to change names:
Set the config for Ultimate Villager Manager as described above.
Then just leave my mod's config as the defaults. The defaults are:
[list]
[*]DoChangeNames = false (because it is handled by UVM)
[*]DoChangeExtraNames = true (handles a few extra things that UVM currently doesn't).
[*]KrobusNewName = Lewis
[/list]

If [b]not[/b] using Ultimate Villager Manager, but want to change the name in some places.
[list]
[*]DoChangeNames = true
[*]DoChangeExtraNames = true
[*]KrobusNewName = Lewis
[/list]
Note that it won't change any dialogue, just his name in the menu/portrait.

If you don't want any name changes, set my config to:
[list]
[*]DoChangeNames = false
[*]DoChangeExtraNames = false
[*]KrobusNewName doesn't matter.
[/list]

[line]

Known Issues:
Due to the fact that Krobus is typically smaller than Lewis (16x24 pixels instead of 16x32), there are a few issues that aren't solvable with just Content Patcher. Some places in the C# code hard code the size so you can't fix it without a C# mod / Harmony. This includes:
[list]
[*]The mysterious thief shadow person uses the same sprites as Krobus but hardcoded size so he looks like a legless lewis.
[*]The event when the dwarf goes to the sewer. The first frame of Krobus is messed up.
[/list]Maybe I'll fix it at some later point, not sure if it's worth the effort though.
